name: Award of ₹20,000/- to Best Writers
benefit: - **Cash Prize:** ₹20,000/- to each of the selected writers (10 from Adi Dravidar/Tribal communities and one from other communities). - **Recognition:** Selected writers receive state recognition for their literary contributions.
_eligibility_text:
- The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
  - The beneficiary should be an unemployed writer.
  - The beneficiary should belong to the Adi Dravidar/ Tribal/ Adi Dravidar converted to Christian community.
